name: 曲面屏影音娱乐智能手机款
description: 星空旗舰开场、性能与屏幕卖点、影音场景到信任收口的智能手机整机套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep space navy gradient #0A1633 with subtle horizon glow for launch and infographic shots, charcoal black #17191C for detail and pain shots, one clean light mist-grey panel #E9EDF2 reserved for trust content
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral-cool studio lighting, soft diffused key with a rim light tracing metallic edges, soft contact shadows, gentle reflections on dark surfaces
styleLock.surfaceSystem: dark reflective glass surface #17191C and matte charcoal board, light mist-grey matte board #E9EDF2 for flat lays
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines, white #FFFFFF text on dark panels and charcoal #2D2D2D text on the light panel
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and rounded outlined info cards in tech-blue #1E9FFF, consistent stroke weight
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale and accurate proportions, straight edges kept straight, screens always rendered as neutral abstract gradients with no real UI; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tech smartphone launch visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep space navy #0A1633, charcoal black #17191C, clean white #FFFFFF and one tech-blue accent #1E9FFF, with white text #FFFFFF on dark panels and charcoal text #2D2D2D on the single light mist-grey panel #E9EDF2; neutral-cool studio lighting with a soft rim light tracing metallic edges and soft contact shadows; cosmic gradient backgrounds with a subtle horizon glow, one clean light panel reserved for trust content; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent thin-line icon and rounded info-card style; screens always rendered as neutral abstract gradients with no real UI; stable product scale, straight edges and accurate proportions; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warped straight lines.

shots.intent: 星空地平线大场景营造旗舰感，赢下详情页第一屏注意力
shots.camera: rear 45-degree angle, product slightly elevated and floating, full product visible
shots.lighting: cool rim light from the upper right tracing metallic edges, soft ambient fill, gentle reflection below
shots.background: deep space navy gradient #0A1633 with a tech-blue #1E9FFF horizon glow and faint star specks
shots.textZone: top area: one small pill badge 「{callout_3}」, one short headline 「{callout_1}」 and one short subline 「{callout_2}」 in white #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce launch hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown from a rear 45-degree angle, slightly elevated and floating above a glowing horizon arc, full back panel and camera module facing the camera, full product visible, the product filling 50-60% of the frame. Deep space navy gradient background #0A1633 with a subtle tech-blue #1E9FFF horizon glow and faint star specks. Cool rim light tracing the metallic edges from the upper right, soft ambient fill, a gentle reflection under the product. The top of the frame carries one small pill badge 「{callout_3}」, one short headline 「{callout_1}」 and one short subline 「{callout_2}」 in white #FFFFFF, completing one balanced composition. Negative: no brand logos or model names, no garbled text, no dense copy, no watermark, no real phone UI, no cut-off edges, no extra decorative stickers.

shots.background: charcoal black #17191C with a soft tech-blue #1E9FFF glow behind the product
shots.textZone: upper-right: one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in white #FFFFFF and three thin-line icon labels 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 in #1E9FFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product standing upright on a dark reflective surface, photographed at a front 3/4 eye-level angle with lower-left placement, the product filling 50-60% of the frame, screen showing a neutral abstract tech-blue gradient with no UI. Charcoal black background #17191C with a soft tech-blue #1E9FFF glow behind the product. Soft diffused key light from the upper left plus a rim light on the right edge, soft contact shadow and a faint reflection. The upper right of the frame carries one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in white #FFFFFF and three thin-line icon labels 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 in #1E9FFF, completing one balanced composition. shots.intent: 用卡顿死板的旧机状态放大痛点，右侧亮出本机流畅解法
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical eye-level documentary camera on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat and dim, right panel clean and bright with a soft key from the upper left
shots.props: a plain desk surface under both phones
shots.textZone: one short pain label 「{callout_1}」 on the left panel and one short solution label 「{callout_2}」 on the right panel in white #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical framing and an eye-level documentary camera. Left panel: a generic unbranded smartphone lying on a desk with a frozen buffering circle on a dimmed neutral screen, dull grey cast #6B7280 conveying lag and stutter. Right panel: {product} standing bright and responsive with a vivid neutral abstract gradient screen. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel lit flat and dim, right panel lit clean and bright with a soft key from the upper left. Background charcoal black #17191C on both panels. One short pain label 「{callout_1}」 on the left and one short solution label 「{callout_2}」 on the right in white #FFFFFF. Each phone fills 50-60% of its panel so both sides read as full compositions. Negative: no real brand phones, no recognizable faces, no fabricated test data or statistics, no dense text, no watermark, no garbled UI elements.

Two horizontal comparison bars stacked center: the upper bar in tech-blue #1E9FFF labeled 「{selling_point_4}」, the lower bar in muted grey #6B7280 labeled 「{selling_point_5}」, both bars ending without any numbers, labels in white #FFFFFF. One short headline 「{callout_1}」 centered above the bars. Even soft infographic lighting, no dramatic shadows. The bars, headline and product together form one centered balanced layout filling 40-50% of the frame. shots.textZone: one small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in white #FFFFFF near the edge

provenance.notes: 从 9 张曲面屏智能手机整机爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌与型号名、二维码与会员引导角标、真人模特肖像、原文案与全部具体参数（5G/刷新率/像素/跑分等均以 {selling_point_n} / {callout_n} 文案槽位由使用方填写），产品一律以 {product} 占位，屏幕内容保持中性抽象渐变、不出现任何真实品牌 UI。
